name: File System
description: Read, write, patch, search, discover, attach and share local files, documents and images.
progressive_guidance: Use file for text, documents, images, edits and attachments; file.readPdf for PDF text and visuals. Use ripgrep for discovery/search, preparing document batches with file.prepareDocumentSearch. Read occupied destinations; patch updates without changing unrelated content. A requested output path does not authorize discarding its contents: save an exact, unique recoverable copy before full replacement, including shell writes. Resolve ordinary collisions without owner confirmation. Verify the new output and preserved bytes before completion; retain and briefly report the saved copy. If evidence is missing, verify or recover with tools. Keep shared files on Leon’s host. Use miniserve for read-only LAN browser links and magic_wormhole for encrypted live internet transfers. Both require the host to remain running; shares expire or can be stopped. These tools do not upload files into third-party cloud storage.
